colors.description: The disc's item icon palette as #rrggbb, by `color`. Index 9 is an empty slot no item uses

item.$comment: Names are in data/strings, keyed by this ID: the NA (ULUS-10391) English name in en.json 'item', other English spellings (EU, MHP2G fan patch, FUComplete, datamine enum, and old spellings of this repo's recipe data) in en.json 'aliases.item', the JP (ULJM-05500) name in ja.json 'item'.

id.description: u16 item ID as stored in the save's item box / pouch

rarity.description: From the disc's item table (mhfu-extract build-data). Omitted on placeholders

carry.description: Carry limit, from the disc's item table. 255 on Normal S Lv1, which is unlimited. Omitted on placeholders

price.description: Price in zenny, from the disc's item table: the shops' buy price for items they sell. Omitted on placeholders

icon.description: Icon shape, from the disc's item table: the sprite at apps/blacksmith/public/images/item-<icon>.png (mhfu-extract item-icons). Omitted on placeholders

color.description: Icon tint, from the disc's item table: an index into `colors`. Omitted on placeholders

regions.description: Releases that carry a real name for this ID. Omitted when present in all of jp, us, eu.

placeholder.description: Not a real item (UI placeholder / developer padding)
